ChatGPT powiedział:

It’s usually called packaging filler or packing material.

  • Packing peanuts — small foam pieces that fill empty space.

  • Bubble wrap — plastic wrapping with air bubbles to protect items.

  • Void fill — material used to fill empty space inside a package.

  • Packing paper — crumpled paper used to cushion items.

  • Inserts — shaped pieces placed inside a package to hold an item in place.

If you mean the material that fills the empty space in a shipping box, void fill is probably the term you're looking for.
